import pytesseract

from fpdf import FPDF

from google.oauth2 import service_account

# 1. DATA EXTRACTION (OCR)
# This section parses key metrics like the 203.5 hours and 32 staff members.
def extract_schedule_data(image_path):
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(Image.open(image_path))
    # Logic to parse specific fields like 'Hours Today' or 'Total Week Hours'
    return text

# 2. PDF GENERATION
class ScheduleReport(FPDF):
    def header(self):
        self.set_font('Arial', 'B', 15)
        self.cell(0, 10, 'Fareway Weekly Operational Report', 0, 1, 'C')

    def add_metrics_section(self, working, hours, total_week):
        self.set_font('Arial', '', 12)
        self.cell(0, 10, f"Staff Working Today: {working}", 0, 1)
        self.cell(0, 10, f"Daily Labor Hours: {hours}", 0, 1)
        self.cell(0, 10, f"Total Weekly Projected Hours: {total_week}", 0, 1)

# 3. GOOGLE DRIVE EXPORT
def upload_to_drive(file_path):
    # Authenticate using your Google Cloud project credentials
    SCOPES = ['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file']
    creds = service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file('credentials.json', scopes=SCOPES)
    service = build('drive', 'v3', credentials=creds)

    file_metadata = {'name': 'Fareway_Schedule_Analysis.pdf'}
    media = MediaFileUpload(file_path, mimetype='application/pdf')
    
    file = service.files().create(body=file_metadata, media_body=media, fields='id').execute()
    print(f"File ID: {file.get('id')} uploaded successfully.")

# MAIN EXECUTION LOGIC

# - Peak Staffing: 20 at 4 PM

import streamlit as st
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
from fpdf import FPDF
import io

st.set_page_config(page_title="Fareway Schedule Tool", page_icon="🛒")
st.title("Fareway Schedule Visualizer")

        with st.spinner('Analyzing schedule...'):

import glob
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract
from fpdf import FPDF
